Exponential-age stationarity and product coherent states yield exact C(h)=e^{-rh}Cov(m(A),m(A+h)) for i!=j. Four explicit Laplace moments reconstruct the cosine/sine coefficients; the derivative numerator 10q^4+17q^2-2 has exactly one positive zero and the static comparator has exactly one other maximum. Numerical checker passed 42 finite diagnostics, which serve only as consistency evidence; the analytic derivation is the proof.
